notes: Two chained stages (dependent_stages=1): derive the struct layout and gate constant from C source, then craft an exact byte payload (TAG_LEN filler + little-endian PERMIT_MAGIC) that flips the adjacent control word, plus a reusable crafter that parses the constants from any conforming source. Covers C-1aefef55 (byte-level payload overwriting an adjacent field to bypass a check) at medium: an underrun, wrong length, big-endian encoding, or wrong value keeps the gate locked. reasoning_depth=2 (C struct layout, endianness, define parsing); debugging_ambiguity=2 because failures only ever print LOCKED, so the agent must infer the offset/value from source alone; quantitative_correctness=2 (exact byte count and exact 32-bit value). generalization=2 (hidden gate builds with different TAG_LEN, decimal/hex/suffixed magics incl. a leading-zero-byte value); adversarial_inputs=1. No resource pressure; totals bucket to medium.
